text:
Maya: Quick cross-team check — we're cutting over v2 proxy routing this Friday. I want one-line status from each owner: gateway, SDK, docs, infra. Call out any blockers and whether you need a canary window.

Sam: Gateway ✅ core routing PR merged, awaiting canary config rollout. No blockers on the proxy side. Need infra to confirm traffic-shaping rules for 100qps canary. :thumbsup:

Leila: SDKs — node and python releases are staged. Node tests flaky on a high-latency env (repro'd). Will attempt hotfix today, but canary ok with 10% traffic for the first hour. @Sam can you hold the canary at 10% for first hour?

Dmitri: Infra — will apply the traffic-shaping and qos rules. I have a terraform change that needs a quick review from @Aisha. If approved by EOD, can apply and start the canary. Otherwise we delay to Monday.

Natalie: Docs-bot: docs PR for v2 deprecation pages is up: https://git.internal/docs/pulls/384. Need one tech-review for the migration example snippet. Also adding SDK migration notes.

Aisha: Reviewing tf PR now. Two minor comments (autoscale cooldown, and a missing tag). If Sam/Leila are fine with 10%/1h canary, I can merge and apply in ~90m.

Sam: 10% for 1h sounds good. After that move to 30% for 2h, then 100% if no regressions. If Leila's hotfix lands, we'll bump to 30% earlier.

Leila: Hotfix branch created, running unit + smoke. If everything green, I'll cut the release by 16:30 UTC. If not, we'll stick to staged ramp.

Maya: Thanks. Can we confirm the rollback playbook? I don't want manual chaos. Dmitri, can infra attach the fallback rule to auto-route to v1 if the v2 health score drops below threshold?

Dmitri: Yup — we have a dynamic routing rule. Health check thresholds: error rate > 2% for 5m OR p95 latency > 600ms for 3m => automatic reroute to v1. I'm adding an alert to paging policy too.

Sam: Added a small feature-flag toggle for clients:
```json
{"feature_flags": {"use_v2_api": true}}
```
We'll flip on server-side routing once SDKs are confirmed.

Natalie: I'll add a short migration note in the docs with the flag example and a snippet for graceful fallback.

Maya: Last asks — @docs-bot please post the final docs link in #product-release when merged. @deploy-bot can you schedule the canary deploy for 18:00 UTC and add the rollback runbook to the deploy notes?

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy for 1977760800 (Fri 18:00 UTC). Rollback runbook attached to job 5521. :rocket:

Maya: Awesome. Action items: Aisha merge tf, Leila cut hotfix (if green), Sam coordinate canary ramp, Dmitri attach alerts, Natalie finalize docs. Ping back here when your item is done.

Sam: Will ping when first 10% is live. :eyes:

Leila: Hotfix green, cutting release now.

Aisha: TF merged and applied.

Dmitri: Alerts in place, auto-reroute rules live.

Natalie: Docs merged and posted to product channel.

Sam: 10% canary live at 18:01 UTC. Monitoring.

Maya: Closing the loop — if no issues, we'll follow the ramp schedule. Thanks everyone. :tada:
